claim: Solana base fee is 5,000 lamports/signature ≈ $0.00075 at $150/SOL — already ~2.5x a $0.0003 call
Solana realistic median all-in tx cost ~$0.0011 (range $0.0001–$0.0025); the '$0.017 average' is outlier-skewed, not typical
Each new payee's Associated Token Account requires 0.00203928 SOL ≈ $0.30 rent — ~1,000x a $0.0003 call (recoverable on close)
No chain finalizes in microseconds. Solana ~0.4–0.6s optimistic confirmation, ~12.8s deterministic finality (32 slots). 'Microsecond' figures come from off-chain matching engines / sequencer preconfs
Fastest interactive on-chain signal is ~100–250ms (Base/OP Flashblocks preconfs), but these are soft preconfirmations, not finality
Solana per-tx fan-out is bound by the 1,232-byte tx size limit (PACKET_DATA_SIZE): ~70 SOL transfers, but only ~10–25 SPL token transfers per tx
note: the ~10–25 figure is community/tooling estimate, not an official constant — pin empirically before committing to Solana

claim: A DAG payout cannot be settled by on-chain recursion (CPI depth ~4 usable levels); the DAG must be flattened off-chain into a flat credit list
EVM DAG fan-out is structurally cheaper: balances[addr]+=amount is a warm 2,900-gas SSTORE, no per-recipient rent, ~60M block gas → hundreds of recipients per tx
x402 (HTTP 402) is the dominant agentic-payment standard: 160M+ autonomous txns yr1, ~95% on Base, gasless USDC (EIP-3009), now Linux-Foundation-governed with batch settlement added
x402-on-Solana traction is overstated: Solana volume ~$7.9M (the '35M+ txns/$10M+' conflates Base's $35M cumulative); Solana share volatile, >78% peak-week txns flagged non-organic
Hedera fees are fixed in USD: $0.0001 HBAR transfer / $0.001 HTS; aBFT 3–5s finality, no reorgs — cheapest predictable floor, but native transfer list capped ~10 adjustments/tx

VERDICT: per-call on-chain settlement is positive only at ≥~$0.05–$0.50/payout with pre-existing accounts and small fan-out — SkillNet meets none. Use off-chain Ed25519 vouchers + DAG netting + threshold/timer batch settlement on Base (reuse EVM contracts + x402/USDC), keep Hedera HCS-26 as registry, Solana only if throughput-bound (internal-ledger PDA, never per-recipient transfers)
